scope: INT35 paid-answer persistence, exact verified candidate application, replay dispatch and stable IDs, Node projections, and collector deduplication

examined: Completed answers are written before actual verification; prior answers replay by exact question digest before any new dispatch.
Verifier hooks bind proposal index, kind, before draft, candidate text, return/group members, round and attempt.
Application must match the exact verified after-draft hash; unsuccessful checkpoint persistence rolls in-memory application state back.
Replay reconstructs verifier outcomes and stable journal/question/candidate IDs; new runs use distinct journal IDs.
Collector deduplicates stable IDs and permits unapplied-to-applied progression without counting repeated accepted outcomes.

counterexamples_found.issue: Interview outcomes refused by kitchen-only inventory availability check
counterexamples_found.concrete_case: An interview call with an explicit folded outcome and the expected missing kitchen verified_outcomes error threw before reaching the interview branch.
counterexamples_found.source_correction_read: Availability refusal moved inside writer === kitchen branch.
counterexamples_found.verification_scope: Read-only source correction verified; maintained regression results belong to CI owner final receipt.

counterexamples_found.issue: Prior applied outcome IDs compared in incompatible order
counterexamples_found.concrete_case: Native emits sorted prior-applied IDs; a checkpoint containing two IDs in reverse lexical proposal order was compared without sorting and would reject a valid replay.
counterexamples_found.source_correction_read: Collector compares native array with sorted validated prior-applied IDs.
counterexamples_found.verification_scope: Read-only source correction verified; maintained regression results belong to CI owner final receipt.

limits: No source edits, paid calls, broad tests, or production qualification performed by this review.
A bounded review and the absence of another concrete counterexample are not proof of exhaustive defect freedom.
The source hashes apply to the completed read; subsequent source epochs require their own captured validation.
